### problem_chain

Walked from the root using only the rules and the seed:

- Root problem: the customer's ask — "send the missing amount to my mom's GCash" on the $380 transfer PW-460925-42618 (wallet_transfers b83fe068…2014, Express, credited, disclosed receive_amount 21273.12, credit f56e50ac delivered 20676.56 at 54.412 vs locked 55.9819). Notice d633dd41 (incorrect_amount, 2026-09-28), decision f399c739 (error_found, 2026-10-02). Policy: wallet_ext_shortfall_recredit ("the customer may choose to have the shortfall re-credited to the same wallet (remedy_choice recredit_shortfall)"); tool choose_shortfall_recredit_f54302ef, owner=user.
- Prerequisite sentences in the root rule:
  1. "The amount a shortfall re-credit delivers is fixed only after Paloma's own shortfall credit stands on the transfer's ledger." Seed: b83fe068's ledger holds 0f62cb92 funds_received, f5b7e3ba fee_charged, f56e50ac credit_sent, 20806192 fee_refunded — no wallet_paloma_credit → unmet at 2026-10-06T11:20. The rule that books such a credit: wallet_ext_shortfall_makegood ("Paloma owes a make-good for the shortfall: one wallet_paloma_credit entry with credit_reason incorrect_amount_shortfall") → book_shortfall_makegood_2311834f (agent). kind value_input (held_usd, size points).
  2. "A shortfall re-credit is not sent to a wallet until no earlier-booked transfer of the same customer addressed to that wallet number stands with a failed credit." Seed: c8080fce…239a booked 2026-09-21T19:42 (< b83fe068's 2026-09-25T20:06), wallet_number 09178524416 (= b83fe068's), status credit_failed → unmet. The rule that takes a transfer out of credit_failed with an available tool: wallet_ext_resend_credit ("When a bounced credit is sent again to the same wallet at the customer's instruction … the transfer returns to processing") → resend_failed_credit_8d2e2e1a (agent). kind state_gate. The customer's instruction is elicitable (persona, above).
- Prerequisite sentences of wallet_ext_resend_credit: "For a resend beyond the tier's free resends, the amount it credits is fixed only after the charge assessed for that resend stands on the transfer's ledger." The resend number = credits already sent on c8080fce = 2 (6e967dc4 attempt 1, f03e8425 attempt 2); Express free_retries = 1 → beyond. c8080fce's ledger has no retry_fee entry → unmet. Resolver: wallet_ext_resend_charge ("one wallet_fee_charged entry with fee_type retry_fee … whose fee_seq is the resend's number") → charge_resend_fee_8300b1da (agent). kind value_input (paid_charge → paid uplift).
- wallet_ext_resend_charge and wallet_ext_shortfall_makegood carry no prerequisite sentence (prerequisite []); their own eligibility holds (retry window: failed_at date 2026-09-24 + 14 days = 2026-10-08 ≥ 2026-10-06; max_retries 2 vs one customer retry so far; status credit_failed; error_found on the notice).
- Derived tree: nodes {shortfall_recredit (root, user), shortfall_makegood (agent), resend_credit (agent), resend_charge (agent)}; edges makegood →(value_input) root, resend_credit →(state_gate) root, resend_charge →(value_input) resend_credit. Prerequisite problems n = 3; value_input edges = 2 ≥ max(n − 1, 1) = 2; one owner=user problem (the root); acyclic.
- Topological order: resend_charge → resend_credit; shortfall_makegood anywhere before the root; root last. The two in-edges of the root act on different transfers (c8080fce vs b83fe068): no shared balance, cap or dedup key, so make-good-first and resend-first give the same terminal state.
- Load-bearing runs (auditor's recomputation, charter compute over seed + simulated writes):
  - skip the make-good: re-credit held_usd = 0.00 → amount delivered 0.00 instead of 763.71.
  - skip the resend: the gate stays false (c8080fce credit_failed) → the re-credit may not be sent at all.
  - skip the charge: resend credit 71753.86 instead of 71825.41 (paid uplift 0 instead of 0.10).
- Tools do not judge prerequisites: the bodies of `charge_resend_fee_8300b1da`, `resend_failed_credit_8d2e2e1a`, `book_shortfall_makegood_2311834f`, `choose_shortfall_recredit_f54302ef` contain no check on any other row and no error branch (`_difficulty.md` § action_binding_and_uuids).
- Persona raises only the root: "You are not thinking about any other transfer today and you do not bring one up"; the older transfer is acknowledged only "If the agent tells you that an older transfer … has to go out again first". The persona names no other item of work ("no statement, no letter, no callback, no human") and closes when "the agent tells you the re-credit for your mother is on its way" — the root write.
- Isomorphism with the declared graph (`prerequisite` fields): identical nodes, edges, kinds.
